name: read_file_partial
description: Read a contiguous slice of lines from a file inside the workspace. Useful for large files. Returns the requested lines plus offset, returned line count, and total line count.

detailed: Reads a slice of lines from a file.
whimsical: Take just the pages you need.

friendly: {source} is reading part of a file
whimsical: {source} is peering at a single page

detailed: tool {participantRole} is reading partial file contents

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to read.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first line to return.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Must be greater than zero.
